designProjects.title: Nordic Monolith Identity
designProjects.description: A complete typographic and geometric identity system for a Scandinavian architectural atelier specializing in brutalist concrete and natural pine dwellings.
designProjects.brief: Nordic Monolith required an identity that rejected trendy ornament in favor of structural permanence, timeless proportions, and tactile paper finishes.
designProjects.concept: Rooted in modular slab geometry: the monogram interlocking form reflects load-bearing pillars and negative space channels reminiscent of architectural floorplates.
deliverables: Debossed Foil Business Cards & Embossed Letterhead
highlights: Custom bespoke ligature set for wordmark
Gold distinction award at European Design Showcase 2025

designProjects.title: Hyperion Electronic Music Posters
designProjects.description: Series of 12 silk-screened typographic festival posters exploring audio frequency waveforms, modular synthesis grids, and kinetic typography.
designProjects.brief: Create a visually arresting poster campaign for an experimental sound festival in former industrial power stations across Berlin.
designProjects.concept: Visualizing acoustic resonance through mathematical moiré patterns, extreme tracking typography, and offset spot neon printing.
deliverables: Motion Billboard Animations for Urban LED displays
Artist Access Pass & Wristband Textile Pattern
highlights: Screen printed with luminous phosphorescent inks
Generative waveform patterns scripted in p5.js

designProjects.title: Aethelgard World & UI System
designProjects.description: High-fantasy worldbuilding visual system, rune iconography, and in-game HUD design system for an indie action-RPG title.
designProjects.brief: Develop a coherent visual language marrying ancient runic carvings with crisp, modern game HUD readability.
designProjects.concept: Distilling Norse petroglyphs into high-precision vector geometries capable of scaling from a 16px mini-map indicator to 4K cinematic titles.
deliverables: Full Vector Glyph Set (140+ custom combat & skill runes)
Steam Store Assets & Promotional Key Visuals
highlights: Tested for legibility at sub-second glance intervals
Pixel-perfect SVG sprite system integrated into Unreal Engine 5

designProjects.title: Zenith Aerospace Monogram & System
designProjects.description: Precision aerodynamic logomark and livery system for a commercial satellite payload deployment carrier.
designProjects.brief: Create a logo that communicates orbital trajectory, mathematical precision, and uncompromising reliability.
designProjects.concept: A continuous single-stroke möbius ribbon representing planetary orbit, accelerating upward at an exact 45-degree angle of ascension.
deliverables: Rocket Fairing & Ground Transport Decal Specs
highlights: Tested against vibration and thermal extremes for launch vehicle placement
Constructed with golden ratio parabolic curves

designProjects.title: Kanso Tea Craft & Visual System
designProjects.description: Sustainable washi paper packaging, embossed canister tin typography, and visual brand identity for single-origin ceremonial matcha.
designProjects.brief: Translate the quiet reverence of Japanese tea ceremony into a sustainable contemporary packaging range for international tea connoisseurs.
designProjects.concept: Honoring 'Kanso' (simplicity) — allowing negative space, raw unbleached fibers, and blind debossing to carry tactile prestige without plastic lamination.

designProjects.title: Nexus Magazine Typography & Editorial
designProjects.description: A 180-page quarterly publication celebrating cybernetic literature, generative art, and speculative architecture.
designProjects.brief: Design a print journal that treats code, algorithms, and speculative fiction as fine art.
designProjects.concept: Asymmetric page columns, exposed thermal binding, fluorescent silver metallic ink overlays, and machine-readable margin barcodes.
deliverables: Limited Slipcase with Laser Die-cut Apertures
Interactive Web Companion with WebGL Article Reader
highlights: Printed on 5 mixed paper stocks (vellum, metallic, uncoated newsprint)
Sold out 2,500 initial print run within 72 hours
